mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (current level 0.09) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals labor market weakness and reduced consumer spending, triggering negative equity market sentiment and producing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods following UNRATE > 6.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate contracting consumer demand and business activity, generating negative equity market reactions and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods following concurrent HOUST and INDPRO declines over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0%) triggers aggressive Federal Reserve tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during inflationary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods following CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 142.0 million) signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 142.0 million over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market contraction (HOUST < 1400.0 thousand units) signals weakening consumer demand for durable goods, triggering negative equity market sentiment and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods following HOUST < 1400.0 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent inflation acceleration (CPIAUCSL rise) and policy tightening (FEDFUNDS rise) signal aggressive monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods following concurrent CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rises over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates supply-side constraints and reduced corporate output, generating negative equity market reactions and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during supply shocks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods following INDPRO < 100.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
